function.name: subagent_watch
function.description: Get the current state of an active subagent or a completed subagent whose result is still queued for delivery, including its kind, depth, and status. Only subagents in your own subtree can be watched.

agent.description: The id of the subagent to inspect (e.g. "agent-7"), as returned by subagent_spawn or subagent_list.
